title: English Practice Quiz 0797
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 01: A conflict of interest occurs when?
options: personal interests may influence work decisions
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: personal interests may influence work decisions.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 02: An inappropriate supplier gift should be handled by?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: following the organisation's gift policy.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 03: Whistleblowing means?
options: reporting suspected wrongdoing through appropriate channels
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: reporting suspected wrongdoing through appropriate channels.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 04: Professional boundaries require staff to?
options: keep decisions appropriate to their role
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: keep decisions appropriate to their role.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 05: Equal treatment at work means?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: applying fair and consistent standards.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 06: If you witness harassment, you should?
options: use the appropriate reporting and support process
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: use the appropriate reporting and support process.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 07: Confidentiality may be limited when?
options: disclosure is legally required or authorised
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: disclosure is legally required or authorised.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 08: An ethical decision should consider?
options: rules, evidence, fairness and potential harm
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: rules, evidence, fairness and potential harm.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 09: A professional who makes an error should?
options: report it honestly and help correct it
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: report it honestly and help correct it.

questions.question: Workplace Ethics 10: A code of conduct explains?
options: expected standards of behaviour and responsibilities
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: expected standards of behaviour and responsibilities.
